items.title: Sustainability leadership moves
items.summary: As corporate sustainability matures, some long-time leaders are leaving the profession, while others are tackling a broader set of responsibilities following reorganizations or layoffs.

items.title: How asset manager Apollo turns sustainability into financial value
items.summary: Jaycee Pribulsky, chief sustainability officer at Apollo Global Management, credits her early government experience, including at the Agency for International Development, with setting the foundation for her long-term tenure in sustainability and supply chain work at footwear company Nike.

items.title: Heathrow expansion like ‘pouring petrol on a raging wildfire’, report warns
items.summary: A new report from Friends of the Earth has emphasised that expanding Heathrow Airport is incompatible with the UK’s legally binding climate targets.

items.title: The rise of the responsible communicator in the trust economy
items.summary: As greenwashing rules tighten, brands must move beyond silence and build trust through credible, evidence-based comms, argues chief executive of The Anti-Greenwash Charter, Charlie Martin.

items.title: The reporting-to-marketing handoff: What does successful sustainability communications look like?
items.summary: Exclusive: The Anti-Greenwash Charter recently held a roundtable with major purpose-led brands to uncover why organisations are reluctant to communicate sustainability and what can be done about.

items.title: TWO WEEKS to go until edie’s Sustainable Supply Chains Summit
items.summary: Join us on 17 September for a unique opportunity to gain expert-led insights through thought leadership and industry panels featuring top professionals in sustainability, supply chain and procurement.

items.title: From ESOS, SECR & TCFD to UK SRS: How to prioritise sustainability information for more efficient reporting
items.summary: Event Date: 13/10/2026 | 1:00 pm UK | 8:00 am US East Coast ET | 5:00 am US West Coast PT | 2:00 pm Central Europe CET/CEST This webinar will provide sustainability professionals with practical guidance on connecting existing ESOS, SECR and TCFD-aligned reporting processes with UK SRS, using materiality filters to prioritise decision-useful information, reduce duplication and develop more efficient, assurance-ready disclosures.

items.title: TWO WEEKS TO GO: Preparing UK businesses for European sustainability reporting requirements
items.summary: With just two weeks to go, edie’s new webinar will explore what the European Sustainability Reporting Standards for Third-Country Groups (ESRS-TC) could mean for UK-headquartered businesses.

items.title: Global warming will cross 1.5C even under most optimistic scenario, says UN
items.summary: Global warming is set to cross 1.5C above pre-industrial levels within the next decade under every scenario examined by the UN, including its most optimistic pathway, according to a new report that warns the overshoot will carry lasting consequences.

items.title: Tate & Lyle updates SBTi targets across expanded footprint
items.summary: Following its acquisition of CP Kelco in 2024, Tate & Lyle has this week (2 September) announced an update to its science-based emissions targets.
